Herald,Ⓒs.ⒹGozakaH, baMdin m., rAjadUtaH.
Ⓑ
 2 (fig.) agradUtaH, praTamavArtAharaH, agresaraH.

Herb,Ⓒs.ⒹozaDi-DI f., SAkaH, SAkalatA, ha-ritakaM.

Herculean,Ⓒa.ⒹBagIraTa in comp.; ‘h(erculean) efforts’ BagIraTaprayatnAH.
Ⓑ
 2 atiprabala, atiSaktimat.

Herd,Ⓒs.ⒹyUTaM, gaRaH, saMGaH, vfMdaM, kadaMbaH, kulaM, samUhaH, vrajaH, nivahaH; ‘h(erd) of cattle’ go-kulaM, pASavaM, govfMdaM, gotrA; ‘h(erd) of oxen’ OkzaRaM; ‘h(erd) of calves’ vAtsakaM; ‘h(erd) of elephants’ hAstikaM.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹyUTena car 1 P, yUTaSaH saMmil 6 P or saMgam 1 A, ekIBU, ekatra BU or mil.
ⓃHerdsman,Ⓒs.ⒹgorakzakaH, gopAlaH, gopaH, goDuk, ABIraH, gosaMKyaH, ballavaH.

Here,Ⓒadv.Ⓓatra, iha (gen. in this world).
Ⓑ
 2 iha loke; ex. by demon. pron.; ‘h(ere) comes your mother’ ezAgacCati te mAtA; ‘h(ere) am I’ ayamasmi.
ⒺInterj.ⒹBo BoH; ‘h(ere) and there’ itastataH; aMtarAMtarA, asamagraM, asaMpUrRaM; ‘h(ere) about’ ito nAtidUre, iha samIpe; ‘h(ere)-after’ itaH paraM-UrDvaM, ataH, parataH, parastAt, anaMtaraM, paScAt, uttarataH, uttaratra, agre, uparizwAt, ataH paraM; (in the next world) paratra, amutra, paraloke; (s.) uttara-kAlaH, para-BAvi-AgAmi-kAlaH; ‘h(ere)-at’ a-trAMtare, aTa; ‘h(ere)-by’ anena, tasmAt, ‘h(ere)-in’ atra, atra-sTAne-vizaye; ‘h(ere)-before’ itaH pUrva, pUrvakAle, purA, prAk, atIta-gata-kAle; ‘h(ere)-upon’ tataH, anaMtaraM, tadupari, tacCrutvA.

Hereditary,Ⓒa.ⒹpitfpEtAmaha (hI f.), pitrya, pOtfka (kI f.), paraMparIRa-ya, paraMparAgata, paraM-parAprApta, kramAyAta, kramAgata, kulakramAgata, anvayAgata; ‘h(ereditary) disease’ saMcArI rogaH; ‘h(ereditary) servant’ mUlaBftyaH, mOlaH; ‘h(ereditary) succession’ kramAgatatvaM.
Ⓝ[Hereditari]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹkulakrameRa, vaMSakrameRa, paraMparayA, pAraMparyeRa.

Heresy,Ⓒs.ⒹpAzaMqamArgaH, nAstikatA, miTyA-dfzwi f., viDarmaH, viDarmasevA, paraDarmASrayaH, apaTaM, vipaTaH.
ⓃHeretic,Ⓒs.ⒹpAzaM(KaM)qaH, nA-stikaH, viDarmasevin m., paraDarmAvalaMbin m., devaniMdakaH, upaDarmasevin m., svaDarmaBrazwaH-cyutaH, patitaH.
Ⓝ[Heretic]al,Ⓒa.ⒹDarmavirudDa, vipaTa-viDarma-gAmin.
Ⓝ[Heretic]ally,Ⓒadv.ⒹpAzaMqavat, nAstikavat.

Hermit,Ⓒs.ⒹyatiH, tApasaH, tapasvin m., muniH, AraRyakaH, vana-araRya-vAsin m., vAnaprasTaH, vEKAnasaH.
Ⓝ[Hermit]age,Ⓒs.ⒹASramaH, uwajaH-jaM, parRaSAlA.

Hero,Ⓒs.ⒹvIraH, SUraH, BawaH, vikrAMtapuruzaH, pra-mahA-vIraH, jetf m., raTin m., atiraTaH, SO-wIraH.
Ⓑ
 2 (In dramas &c.) nAyakaH, kaTA-puruzaH; ‘h(ero)es of Rāmāyaṇa’ rAmAyaRa-kaTApuruzAH or nAyakAH.
Ⓝ[Hero]ic, [Hero]ical,Ⓒa.ⒹvIra, SUra, pravIra, vikrAMta, vIryavat, amitOjas, mahAvIrya; ‘a h(eroic) deed’ parAkramaH, vikramaH, avadAtaM karma.
Ⓑ
 2 vIracaritravizayaka, vIrarasa-praDAna.
Ⓝ[Hero]ically,Ⓒadv.ⒹsavikramaM, savIryaM, SUravat.
Ⓝ[Hero]ism,Ⓒs.ⒹvIryaM, SUratvaM, SOryaM, parA-vi-kramaH, DAman n., ojas n., raRotsAhaH, pOruzaM, sAhasaM, vIryavattvaM, SOwIryaM.
ⓃHeroine,Ⓒs.ⒹnAyikA.
